algorithm.transport: Offline BVH path tracing of textured Lambertian indirect irradiance
algorithm.textureDecode: 256px scene-linear bilinear base-color and metallic channels
algorithm.interpolation: Four nearest visible same-room probes, inverse-square weights; each receiver-probe segment ray tested against opaque geometry
algorithm.localLightSampling: Finite emitter shadow segments at each diffuse hit; live Three inverse-square/range attenuation, nominal fire centroid energy/radius, no unoccluded ambient term

limitations: Diffuse-only finite-bounce prototype; no glossy/specular transport or caustics.
Original source vertices interpolate the result; this is not a per-texel lightmap or Cycles-equivalent bake.
Only the exact assembled architecture and season interior geometry participate; terrain, foliage and glazing are excluded.
Glass is treated as an open aperture. Direct practical/fire light and animation remain live; only nominal indirect transport is baked.

Four fixtures use their authored spot directions/cones. Relative native powers share the live renderer intensity budget; no watts-to-candela conversion is claimed. Fire uses its finite-radius centroid approximation, not a VDB emission integral.
Native glTF albedo/metallic textures and the shared Poly Haven Concrete Wall 008 albedo at 2.7 metres are evaluated; runtime stochastic wood variation and normal-map microrelief are not traced.
Enable only at the baked season/hour with assembly closed; validate visually before replacing SSGI.
